metadata.question: Did did the total rainfall exceed 8 inches in Canberra, Australia during January 14, 2020 to January 22, 2020?

data.raw_code: 1. Search Strategy: - Location: Canberra, Australia (approximately -35.28°, 149.13°) - Date Range: January 14, 2020 to January 22, 2020 - Dataset: CHIRPS (Climate Hazards Group InfraRed Precipitation with Station data) is the standard for rainfall analysis - Alternative: NOAA/PERSIANN-CDR if CHIRPS unavailable 2. Masking Strategy: - Rainfall data doesn't require cloud masking in the traditional sense - CHIRPS is a gap-filled precipitation dataset, so all pixels should have valid data - No masking needed; focus on summing daily precipitation 3. Logic to Distinguish Valid Zero vs. Null: - Valid Zero: Rainfall = 0 mm (dry period) → Answer B (did not exceed 8 inches) - Valid Value: Sum rainfall in mm, convert to inches, compare to 8 inches - Null/Error: Missing data, collection empty, or calculation returns NaN → Answer C3 or C1 - If total rainfall > 8 inches (203.2 mm) → Answer A - If total rainfall ≤ 8 inches → Answer B ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define Canberra geometry const canberra = ee.Geometry.Point([149.13, -35.28]); const bufferGeom = canberra.buffer(50000); // 50 km buffer for region // 2. Define date range const startDate = '2020-01-14'; const endDate = '2020-01-22'; // 3. Load CHIRPS daily precipitation data let chirps = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY') .filterBounds(bufferGeom) .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .select('precipitation'); const imgCount = chirps.size().getInfo(); console.log(`CHIRPS Images Found: ${imgCount}`); if (imgCount === 0) { console.log('No precipitation data available for date range.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 4. Sum all daily precipitation over the period const totalPrecip = chirps.sum(); // 5. Calculate mean precipitation in mm over Canberra const stats = totalPrecip.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: canberra, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const precipMM = stats['precipitation']; console.log(`Total Precipitation (mm): ${precipMM}`); // Validate result if (precipMM === null || precipMM === undefined || isNaN(precipMM)) { console.log('Calculation failed - invalid result.'); console.log('C3'); return; } // 6. Convert mm to inches (1 inch = 25.4 mm) const precipInches = precipMM / 25.4; console.log(`Total Precipitation (inches): ${precipInches.toFixed(2)}`); // 7. Compare to 8 inches threshold const threshold = 8; if (precipInches > threshold) { console.log(`Result: ${precipInches.toFixed(2)} inches > ${threshold} inches`); console.log('A'); } else { console.log(`Result: ${precipInches.toFixed(2)} inches ≤ ${threshold} inches`); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
